card.name: Broken trademark symbol after product names
card.fires_on: The first piece of a multi-byte symbol, usually the trademark sign, right after a brand or device name such as Mini-Bag Plus, Dispensing Pin or SAFETYGLIDE. It also fires on odd symbols in tables.

modes.label: Trademark after brand
modes.description: A broken symbol directly follows a product or device brand name.

modes.label: Stray symbol in tables
modes.description: A garbled symbol appears after a dosage phrase or inside a table.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a trademark symbol after a brand name is split into pieces.
